title.zh: 美驻欧盟大使警告：若限制星链，将对欧洲企业实施「毁灭性」报复
title.en: 美驻欧盟大使警告：若限制星链，将对欧洲企业实施「毁灭性」报复

current_state.zh: US Ambassador to the EU Andrew Puzder warned that Washington would retaliate 'devastatingly' against European companies if the EU proceeds with plans to reserve satellite spectrum for European firms, limiting SpaceX's Starlink and Chinese competitors.
current_state.en: US Ambassador to the EU Andrew Puzder warned that Washington would retaliate 'devastatingly' against European companies if the EU proceeds with plans to reserve satellite spectrum for European firms, limiting SpaceX's Starlink and Chinese competitors.
